subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook before the generated-wrapper and doctor/install fixes are implemented?
rationale: The patch is docs-only and technically consistent with current source, but it recommends operator launchd mutations that can affect node-service availability, so automation should not decide the product risk.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Fix
options.body: Defer or close this PR until wrapper generation, doctor, or install repair exists so users are not asked to carry a manual launchd workaround.

options.title: Require Narrower Operator Wording
options.body: Ask for maintainer-specified prerequisites around when node LaunchAgent disablement is acceptable before merge.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the docs and launchd runtime surfaces involved in the tradeoff.
